source: MahaDBT Aaple Sarkar State Scholarship Portal

schemes.title: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna (EBC)
schemes.department: Directorate of Higher Education, Government of Maharashtra
schemes.description: 50 percent tuition and examination fee reimbursement for economically backward class students enrolled in professional and non-professional degree courses.

schemes.title: Government of India Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students (Maharashtra)
schemes.department: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra
schemes.description: Full tuition and examination fee concession with maintenance allowance for Scheduled Caste students pursuing post-matric courses in Maharashtra.

schemes.title: Post-Matric Tuition Fee and Examination Fee Freeship for OBC / VJNT / SBC Students
schemes.department: Other Backward Bahujan Welfare Department, Government of Maharashtra
schemes.description: Reimbursement of tuition and exam fees to meritorious and eligible students belonging to OBC, VJNT and SBC categories across colleges in Maharashtra.

schemes.title: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Vasatigruh Nirvah Bhatta Yojna (Hostel Allowance)
schemes.department: Directorate of Higher Education, Government of Maharashtra
schemes.description: Annual hostel maintenance stipend for children of registered agricultural laborers and marginal farmers pursuing technical and professional education.
